expected.classReason: The PoC shows a session signature made for one wallet accepted when another address presents it: the signed hash names no wallet. A harm needs a second wallet that holds the same session configuration and nonce, which the PoC does not set up, so what it shows is a signature not bound to its wallet, with nothing lost and no wallet acted on: the contract falls short of what it promises, Low.
expected.reason: The program judged it medium; the jury is A7d's to measure. Here every gate passes, and the test fails on the bug: its control passes with the assertion turned around.
